unit_talk_review_repair_control.causality_assessment: The chain is stronger than textual resemblance. A specific authenticated application review names two defects; the PM cites them; the next repair changes exactly those points; later PM and deterministic findings cause matching subsequent commits; and the merged documents preserve those dispositions.
unit_talk_review_repair_control.identity_and_operator_assessment: The Codex reviewer is a distinct public GitHub application identity, but that does not independently attest an exact model execution. Every repair commit is authored and committed by griff843. Claude appears only in a lane claim, repository-authored prose and co-author trailers, not as an independently authenticated recipient principal. The repository itself says distinct authenticated reviewers do not exist and that current gates share one owner/application identity.
unit_talk_review_repair_control.authorization_assessment: The review is team-configured, the repairs are owner/PM-directed, the final waiver and merge remain human-governed, and the packet expressly does not activate autonomous merge or runtime behavior.

principal_schema_controls.assessment: Producer/consumer principal fields are schema definitions. The only located inserts are explicit test fixtures. The project describes a local-first governed memory layer in which remote agents submit candidates and a trusted sync host reviews and promotes them. No populated organic transfer/use event is exposed.

The matched sender/recipient and artifact fields define an intentional agent marketplace, hiring/team graph and anti-sybil enforcement. The only located insert is a graph-enforcement test fixture; the selected public records expose no actual task result and recipient use.
The remaining producer/consumer-principal matches are Terraform output and Azure documentation placeholders, not populated AI-participant exchanges.

scoped_prior_reporting_check.result: No prior coordination-incident report was located in the checked scope as of 2026-10-16. The web results were unrelated; the exact GitHub checks returned zero, one generic same-repository specification phrase and four same-repository design/governance paths respectively. This is not a novelty claim, and the primary operator-boundary failure is independently decisive.

advancement_requirements.unit_talk_v2: An independently authenticated repair-side autonomous principal, primary evidence that it was separately operated, and evidence that the review/repair cooperation occurred outside the team-configured PM-controlled workflow. More owner-authored commits, lane labels, co-author trailers or planning documents do not qualify.
advancement_requirements.vault_agent_memory: A populated non-test record tying an exact producer artifact to a distinct recipient's later semantic action, with independently attributable principals and separate-operator authorization evidence.
advancement_requirements.ancap: A public non-test task result, recipient adoption and independently attributable operator provenance. Marketplace schemas, roadmap language and test graph rows do not qualify.
advancement_requirements.general: A specific sender-to-recipient dependency must survive single-operator automation, designed teams, human-directed review, fixtures, schema-only records, retries, shared state and observer-contamination alternatives.

next_record_and_query_cursor.scanner_backlog: Remain paused at 853 of 1,146 inspected reports. Resume the 293-record known-family-controlled remainder only on a source-level cue distinguishing a separate episode or population.
next_record_and_query_cursor.rotation: Continue with immutable public pull-request timelines that combine an authenticated review application, a subsequent semantically matching repair commit and explicit principal/operator evidence. Do not substitute issue trackers or published incident corpora.
next_record_and_query_cursor.family_reentry_rule: Do not re-enter Unit-Talk-v2, Vault-Agent-Memory, ANCAP or the two Azure/Terraform placeholder families without new primary sender/recipient, downstream-use or separate-operator evidence.

checkpoint.summary: Unit-Talk-v2 preserves a concrete Codex-review-to-owner-repair dependency, but its immutable records establish a deliberately configured, PM-controlled workflow and explicitly deny distinct authenticated reviewer identities. Vault-Agent-Memory and ANCAP are schema/test controls. No separate-operator rogue-swarm candidate is established.

limitations: GitHub default-branch code search does not cover deleted history, unindexed branches, private repositories or private runtime state.
Search responses provide row occurrences rather than unique incidents; self-index and overlapping matches were not treated as activity.
A GitHub application identity authenticates the posting integration, not a specific model execution, model provider or independent operator.
Commit co-author trailers, lane labels and repository-authored agent claims are not independent identity attestations.
Two Azure/Terraform matches were classified only from paths and search excerpts and were not used for a substantive event conclusion.
The prior-reporting check is bounded to the listed web and GitHub exact queries and cannot establish universal absence.
No inference about subjective rogue intent, provider attribution or current autonomous activity is made.
